lockscreenControlAnimationEnabled.name: Lock screen control animation
lockscreenControlAnimationEnabled.description: Animate lock screen control button expansion and collapse. Disabling completes the current size transition immediately.
lockscreenControlAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制锁屏按钮展开和收缩动画；关闭时立即完成当前尺寸过渡。

windowOpenAnimationEnabled.name: Window open animation
windowOpenAnimationEnabled.description: Animate normal window opening. Disabling opens the window immediately.
windowOpenAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制普通窗口打开动画；关闭时窗口立即显示。

windowCloseAnimationEnabled.name: Window close animation
windowCloseAnimationEnabled.description: Animate normal window closing. Disabling closes the window immediately.
windowCloseAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制普通窗口关闭动画；关闭时窗口立即关闭。

launchpadOpenAnimationEnabled.name: Launcher open animation
launchpadOpenAnimationEnabled.description: Animate launcher layer surface opening. Disabling shows it immediately.
launchpadOpenAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器图层打开动画；关闭时立即显示。

launchpadCloseAnimationEnabled.name: Launcher close animation
launchpadCloseAnimationEnabled.description: Animate launcher layer surface closing. Disabling hides it immediately.
launchpadCloseAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器图层关闭动画；关闭时立即隐藏。

layerShellOpenAnimationEnabled.name: Layer shell open animation
layerShellOpenAnimationEnabled.description: Animate anchored layer shell surfaces opening. Disabling shows them immediately.
layerShellOpenAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制贴边图层窗口打开动画；关闭时立即显示。

layerShellCloseAnimationEnabled.name: Layer shell close animation
layerShellCloseAnimationEnabled.description: Animate anchored layer shell surfaces closing. Disabling hides them immediately.
layerShellCloseAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制贴边图层窗口关闭动画；关闭时立即隐藏。

maximizeAnimationEnabled.name: Maximize animation
maximizeAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the geometry change when maximizing. Disabling applies the maximized geometry immediately.
maximizeAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制最大化几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用最大化几何。

fullscreenAnimationEnabled.name: Fullscreen animation
fullscreenAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the geometry change when entering fullscreen. Disabling applies the fullscreen geometry immediately.
fullscreenAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制进入全屏的几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用全屏几何。

restoreWindowAnimationEnabled.name: Restore window animation
restoreWindowAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the geometry change when restoring from maximized or fullscreen. Disabling applies the restored geometry immediately.
restoreWindowAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制从最大化或全屏还原的几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用还原几何。

splashTransitionAnimationEnabled.name: Splash transition animation
splashTransitionAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the transition from the prelaunch splash to the real window. Disabling shows the real window immediately.
splashTransitionAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制预启动闪屏到真实窗口的过渡动画；关闭时立即显示真实窗口。

minimizeAnimationEnabled.name: Minimize animation
minimizeAnimationEnabled.description: Animate minimizing a window. Disabling minimizes immediately without the shrink transition.
minimizeAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制窗口最小化动画；关闭时立即最小化，不播放缩小过渡。

restoreMinimizedAnimationEnabled.name: Restore minimized animation
restoreMinimizedAnimationEnabled.description: Animate restoring a minimized window. Disabling restores immediately.
restoreMinimizedAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制最小化窗口的恢复动画；关闭时立即恢复。

showDesktopAnimationEnabled.name: Show desktop animation
showDesktopAnimationEnabled.description: Animate hiding windows when showing the desktop. Disabling hides them immediately.
showDesktopAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制显示桌面时隐藏窗口的动画；关闭时立即隐藏。

restoreShowDesktopAnimationEnabled.name: Restore from desktop animation
restoreShowDesktopAnimationEnabled.description: Animate restoring windows when leaving show-desktop. Disabling restores them immediately.
restoreShowDesktopAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制退出显示桌面时恢复窗口的动画；关闭时立即恢复。

launchpadCoverAnimationEnabled.name: Launcher cover animation
launchpadCoverAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the launcher cover wallpaper zoom and fade. Disabling applies the final state immediately.
launchpadCoverAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器覆盖层的壁纸缩放与淡入淡出；关闭时立即应用最终状态。

wallpaperScaleAnimationEnabled.name: Wallpaper scale animation
wallpaperScaleAnimationEnabled.description: Animate wallpaper scaling on launcher and lock screen transitions. Disabling applies the target scale immediately.
wallpaperScaleAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器和锁屏切换时的壁纸缩放动画；关闭时立即应用目标缩放。

workspaceSwitchAnimationEnabled.name: Workspace switch animation
workspaceSwitchAnimationEnabled.description: Animate sliding between workspaces. Disabling switches workspaces immediately.
workspaceSwitchAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制工作区之间的滑动切换动画；关闭时立即切换。

workspaceVisibilityAnimationEnabled.name: Workspace visibility animation
workspaceVisibilityAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the workspace scale and opacity on lock screen entry and exit. Disabling applies the final scale and opacity immediately.
workspaceVisibilityAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制锁屏进入和退出时工作区的缩放与透明度动画；关闭时立即应用最终缩放和透明度。

workspaceBounceAnimationEnabled.name: Workspace edge bounce animation
workspaceBounceAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the bounce when switching past the first or last workspace. Disabling skips the bounce.
workspaceBounceAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制切换到首个或最后一个工作区时的边界回弹动画；关闭时不播放回弹。

taskSwitcherAnimationEnabled.name: Task switcher mask animation
taskSwitcherAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the Alt-Tab overlay mask fading. Disabling applies the mask opacity immediately.
taskSwitcherAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制 Alt-Tab 遮罩淡入淡出；关闭时立即应用遮罩透明度。

taskSwitcherPanelAnimationEnabled.name: Task switcher panel animation
taskSwitcherPanelAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the Alt-Tab switcher panel sliding in and out. Disabling shows and hides it immediately.
taskSwitcherPanelAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制 Alt-Tab 切换面板的滑入滑出；关闭时立即显示或隐藏。

taskSwitcherThumbnailAnimationEnabled.name: Task switcher thumbnail animation
taskSwitcherThumbnailAnimationEnabled.description: Animate window thumbnails when switching items in Alt-Tab. Disabling switches thumbnails immediately.
taskSwitcherThumbnailAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制 Alt-Tab 缩略图切换动画；关闭时立即切换缩略图。

taskSwitcherExitAnimationEnabled.name: Task switcher exit animation
taskSwitcherExitAnimationEnabled.description: Animate restoring real windows when leaving Alt-Tab. Disabling restores them immediately.
taskSwitcherExitAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制退出 Alt-Tab 时真实窗口的恢复动画；关闭时立即恢复。

multitaskviewEnterAnimationEnabled.name: Multitask view enter animation
multitaskviewEnterAnimationEnabled.description: Animate entering the multitask view. Disabling shows the final layout immediately.
multitaskviewEnterAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制进入多任务视图的动画；关闭时立即显示最终布局。

multitaskviewExitAnimationEnabled.name: Multitask view exit animation
multitaskviewExitAnimationEnabled.description: Animate leaving the multitask view. Disabling hides it immediately after the exit completes.
multitaskviewExitAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制退出多任务视图的动画；关闭时退出后立即隐藏。

multitaskviewLayoutAnimationEnabled.name: Multitask view layout animation
multitaskviewLayoutAnimationEnabled.description: Animate window layout and scale changes in the multitask view. Disabling applies the final layout immediately; dragging stays interactive.
multitaskviewLayoutAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制多任务视图中窗口布局与缩放变化；关闭时立即应用最终布局，拖动交互保留。

multitaskviewEmptyHintAnimationEnabled.name: Multitask view empty hint animation
multitaskviewEmptyHintAnimationEnabled.name[zh_CN]: 多任务空窗口提示动画
multitaskviewEmptyHintAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the empty-window hint opacity in the multitask view. Disabling applies the final opacity immediately.
multitaskviewEmptyHintAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制多任务视图空窗口提示的透明度动画；关闭时立即应用最终透明度。

outputRotationAnimationEnabled.name: Output rotation animation
outputRotationAnimationEnabled.description: Animate rotating the primary output. Disabling applies the rotation and transform immediately.
outputRotationAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制主输出旋转动画；关闭时立即应用旋转和实际 transform。

mirrorOutputRotationAnimationEnabled.name: Mirror output rotation animation
mirrorOutputRotationAnimationEnabled.description: Animate rotating a mirror output. Disabling applies the rotation and transform immediately.
mirrorOutputRotationAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制镜像输出旋转动画；关闭时立即应用旋转和实际 transform。

wallpaperCrossFadeAnimationEnabled.name: Wallpaper cross fade animation
wallpaperCrossFadeAnimationEnabled.description: Cross fade between wallpapers. Disabling switches as soon as the new wallpaper is ready.
wallpaperCrossFadeAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制壁纸之间的交叉渐变；关闭时在新壁纸就绪后立即切换。

loginContentAnimationEnabled.name: Login content animation
loginContentAnimationEnabled.name[zh_CN]: 登录内容滑入滑出动画
loginContentAnimationEnabled.description: Animate lock and login screen content sliding in and out. Disabling shows or hides the content immediately.
loginContentAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制锁屏和登录界面内容的滑入滑出；关闭时立即显示或隐藏。

greeterBackgroundAnimationEnabled.name: Greeter background transition animation
greeterBackgroundAnimationEnabled.description: Animate the greeter background scale and dim transitions. Disabling applies the final state immediately.
greeterBackgroundAnimationEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 控制登录界面背景缩放与变暗过渡；关闭时立即应用最终状态。

showOnLock.name: Show on lock screen
showOnLock.description: Allow show context on lock screen
showOnLock.description[zh_CN]: 允许在锁屏界面上显示内容

lostScreen.name: Behaivor when lost screen
lostScreen.description: Behaivor when lost screen, allow value: MoveToPrimary、Minimize
lostScreen.description[zh_CN]: 丢失屏幕的行为，可选值为：MoveToPrimary、Minimize

preferDark.name: Prefer Dark
preferDark.description[zh_CN]: 颜色方案是否倾向暗色

cursorBlinkTime.name: Cursor Blink Time
cursorBlinkTime.description: Length of the cursor blink cycle, in milleseconds
cursorBlinkTime.description[zh_CN]: 光标闪烁周期的长度，以千秒为单位

doubleClickTime.name: Double Click Time
doubleClickTime.description: Maximum time allowed between two clicks for them to be considered a double click (in milliseconds)
doubleClickTime.description[zh_CN]: 两次单击之间允许被视为双击的最长时间（以毫秒为单位）

doubleClickDistance.name: Double Click Distance
doubleClickDistance.description: Maximum distance allowed between two clicks for them to be considered a double click (in pixels)
doubleClickDistance.description[zh_CN]: 两次单击之间允许被视为双击的最大距离（以像素为单位）

dndDragThreshold.name: Dnd Drag Threshold
dndDragThreshold.description: Number of pixels the cursor can move before dragging
dndDragThreshold.description[zh_CN]: 拖动之前光标可以移动的像素数

windowOpacity.name: Global Window Opacity
windowOpacity.description[zh_CN]: 设置所有窗口的不透明度

windowColorScheme.name: Global Window Color Scheme
windowColorScheme.description[zh_CN]: 配色偏好：0 亮色，1 暗色

windowTitlebarHeight.name: Global Window titlebar height
windowTitlebarHeight.description: Set all window default titlebar height
windowTitlebarHeight.description[zh_CN]: 设置所有窗口默认的标题栏高度

defaultBackground.name: Default background
defaultBackground.description: Set the default displayed wallpaper, when no wallpaper is set
defaultBackground.description[zh_CN]: 当没有设置壁纸时，设置默认显示的壁纸

workspaceThumbCornerRadius.name: Workspace thumbnail corner radius
workspaceThumbCornerRadius.name[zh_CN]: 工作区缩略图圆角弧度
workspaceThumbCornerRadius.description[zh_CN]: 工作区缩略图圆角弧度

minMultitaskviewSurfaceHeight.name: Multitask view surface minimal height
minMultitaskviewSurfaceHeight.name[zh_CN]: 多任务视图表面最小高度
minMultitaskviewSurfaceHeight.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图表面最小高度

multitaskviewPaddingOpacity.name: Multitaskview padding opacity
multitaskviewPaddingOpacity.name[zh_CN]: 多任务视图内边距不透明度
multitaskviewPaddingOpacity.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图内边距不透明度

multitaskviewEasingCurveType.name: Multitaskview easing curve type
multitaskviewEasingCurveType.name[zh_CN]: 多任务视图缓动曲线类型
multitaskviewEasingCurveType.description: Multitaskview easing curve type, enumerate value of QEasingCurve::Type
multitaskviewEasingCurveType.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图缓动曲线类型，其值为QEasingCurve::Type类型的枚举值

multitaskviewTopContentMargin.name: Multitaskview top content margin
multitaskviewTopContentMargin.name[zh_CN]: 多任务视图内容顶边距
multitaskviewTopContentMargin.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图内容顶边距

multitaskviewBottomContentMargin.name: Multitaskview bottom content margin
multitaskviewBottomContentMargin.name[zh_CN]: 多任务视图内容底边距
multitaskviewBottomContentMargin.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图内容底边距

multitaskviewCellPadding.name: Multitaskview cell padding
multitaskviewCellPadding.name[zh_CN]: 多任务视图单元格间距
multitaskviewCellPadding.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图单元格间距

wallpaperConfig.name: Wallpaper Config
wallpaperConfig.description: A configuration to manage wallpapers used by the system, including desktop and lockscreen wallpapers for each screen and workspace.
wallpaperConfig.description[zh_CN]: 用于管理系统当前使用的壁纸配置，包括每个屏幕和工作区的桌面壁纸和锁屏壁纸。

glassEnabled.name: Glass Effect Enabled
glassEnabled.description: Use the Liquid Glass effect for backdrop blur regions instead of the plain blur. When disabled, the traditional Gaussian blur is used with no side effects.
glassEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 是否在背景模糊区域使用液态玻璃效果替代普通模糊。关闭时使用传统高斯模糊，无额外副作用。

blurStrength.name: Blur Strength
blurStrength.description: Maximum blur strength (in pixels) applied to the backdrop blur regions. When set to 0, blur is completely disabled. Range: 0-128.
blurStrength.description[zh_CN]: 背景模糊的最大强度（像素）。设置为 0 时将完全关闭模糊效果。范围：0-128。

glassBezel.name: Glass Bezel Width
glassBezel.description: The rounded edge bevel width in pixels for the Liquid Glass effect. Range: 2-60.
glassBezel.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃效果的圆角边缘倒角宽度（像素）。范围：2-60。

glassThickness.name: Glass Base Thickness
glassThickness.description: The glass thickness in pixels for Liquid Glass refraction. Range: 10.0-200.0.
glassThickness.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃折射使用的玻璃厚度（像素）。范围：10.0-200.0。

blurAmount.name: Blur Amount
blurAmount.description: Normalized blur amount applied by Qt MultiEffect. 0 disables the blur contribution while keeping the effect item alive; default 0.6 uses 60% of the configured blur strength. Range: 0.0-1.0.
blurAmount.description[zh_CN]: Qt MultiEffect 使用的归一化模糊量。0 表示关闭模糊贡献但保留效果项；默认 0.6 表示使用配置模糊强度的 60%。范围：0.0-1.0。

blurMultiplier.name: Blur Multiplier
blurMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to extend the backdrop blur radius. 0 keeps Qt MultiEffect's default-quality blur radius; larger values extend the radius but reduce quality. Range: 0.0-4.0.
blurMultiplier.description[zh_CN]: 用于扩展背景模糊半径的倍率。0 表示使用 Qt MultiEffect 的默认质量模糊半径；值越大会扩展半径但降低质量。范围：0.0-4.0。

glassSaturation.name: Glass Saturation
glassSaturation.description: Saturation adjustment applied by Qt MultiEffect before Liquid Glass refraction. Range: -1.0-1.0.
glassSaturation.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃折射前由 Qt MultiEffect 应用的饱和度调节。范围：-1.0-1.0。

glassSpecular.name: Glass Specular
glassSpecular.description: Specular highlight intensity for the Liquid Glass rim and Fresnel response. 0 disables specular highlights. Range: 0.0-1.0.
glassSpecular.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃边缘高光与菲涅尔响应强度。0 表示关闭高光。范围：0.0-1.0。

glassProfilePower.name: Glass Profile Power
glassProfilePower.description: Surface profile exponent controlling the super-ellipse shape. 2 produces a rounder profile; higher values sharpen the bezel transition. Range: 1.0-10.0.
glassProfilePower.description[zh_CN]: 控制超椭圆形状的表面轮廓指数。2 产生更圆的轮廓；值越高边缘过渡越尖锐。范围：1.0-10.0。

edgeSideTriggerDistance.name: Edge Side Trigger Distance
edgeSideTriggerDistance.description: Distance in pixels from the left/right screen edge at which half-screen tiling triggers
edgeSideTriggerDistance.description[zh_CN]: 距离屏幕左/右边缘多少像素时触发半屏平铺

edgeTopTriggerDistance.name: Edge Top Trigger Distance
edgeTopTriggerDistance.description: Distance in pixels from the top screen edge at which maximize triggers
edgeTopTriggerDistance.description[zh_CN]: 距离屏幕顶部边缘多少像素时触发最大化

edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.name: Edge Quadrant Zone Ratio
edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.name[zh_CN]: 四分之一屏触发区域比例
edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.description: Ratio of the edge length forming the corner (quadrant) tiling zone. Cursor within this ratio of the top/bottom of a side edge tiles to the corner quadrant, the middle zone keeps half-screen tiling. Range: 0.0-0.5
edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.description[zh_CN]: 边缘长度中形成四分之一屏（角落）平铺区域的比值。光标位于左右边缘的上/下该比例范围内时平铺到对应角落象限，中间区域保持半屏平铺。范围：0.0-0.5。

edgeInnerDelayMs.name: Edge Inner Delay
edgeInnerDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before activating edge tiling on an inner edge between screens
edgeInnerDelayMs.description[zh_CN]: 多屏内边延迟激活边缘平铺的毫秒数
